title: BacFlux: a unified Snakemake workflow for bacterial whole-genome sequencing
description:
BacFlux is an automated Snakemake workflow for bacterial whole-genome sequencing data.

Version 2.0.0 unifies four previously separate workflows into one with four entry points — Illumina paired-end reads, Oxford Nanopore reads, hybrid Illumina + Nanopore, and pre-assembled contigs — converging on a single shared analysis spine: decontamination, assembly QC, completeness and contamination, taxonomic placement, functional annotation, secondary metabolites, CAZymes, antimicrobial resistance and virulence screening, plasmid and prophage detection, and an aggregated report.

An optional mobilome module (off by default) reports, for each antimicrobial resistance gene, whether it sits in a mobile genetic element and how transferable that element is predicted to be. Every tool runs in its own conda environment.

Documentation: https://iLivius.github.io/BacFlux/
notes: If you use BacFlux, please also cite the tools whose output you actually used; the full list is in CITATIONS.md in the repository.
